note: Polynesian chant sources, wave 2, issue #6768. Enumerated on archive.org 2026-10-15; every work holdings-checked with check-holdings.ts --title/--author (all NEW). Institutional scans, pre-1931 (1930 imprints are US public domain since 2026-01-01), not access-restricted. Fornander Account vols 1 and 3 complete our held vol. 2 (69e009b7846d79f28d566e5a, title corrected 2026-10-15). Krämer: vol. 1 (1901, legends/genealogies, Samoan with German) and vol. 2 (1902) — confirm volume on title pages. Left out: Journal of the Polynesian Society (a run of ~40 volumes — its own campaign), Churchill's Rapanui speech (linguistics), retellings for children.
